info.brief: The asobi client. `create` builds a client for one asobi server, carrying its tokens and
info.description:
The asobi client. `create` builds a client for one asobi server, carrying its tokens and
the realtime connection, and `quick_start` signs a guest in, connects and queues for a
match in one call.

elements.name: create
elements.brief: Creates a client for an asobi server, with its realtime connection. Nothing connects
elements.description:
Creates a client for an asobi server, with its realtime connection. Nothing connects
until `realtime.connect` is called.

parameters.name: use_ssl
parameters.doc: Whether to use `https` and `wss`. Defaults to `false`.

elements.name: quick_start
elements.brief: Signs a guest in, connects and queues for a match in one call, registering every handler
elements.description:
Signs a guest in, connects and queues for a match in one call, registering every handler
before it connects. The sign-in runs asynchronously, so the client returns at once; use
`create` and the realtime connection directly for entity sync or custom match state.

parameters.name: opts
parameters.doc: The server, the mode and the callbacks.

returnvalues.doc: The client, for disconnecting later or reaching the rest of the API.
